newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Westmond Land stock to requote - KLSE.
newsitem.headline: Westmond Land stock to requote - KLSE.

text.p: The stock of Malaysian plantation and real estate firm Westmont Land (Asia) Bhd will be requoted on Friday, said a Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange official.
The company had late on Thursday asked for requotation of the stock in a statement to the exchange. The stock was suspended from June 19 pending a news announcement.
The company had said in a preliminary statement on June 25 that it was negotiating to buy a major stake in a commercial bank in Uganda.
Westmont Land had also said that it was in the final stages of negotiating the purchase of a 100 megawatt barge-mounted power plant in Africa.
The shares were last traded on June 18 at 3.52 ringgit.
